zh.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: 永远不要再做笔记了——它把「整理」拿走，只留下「喂素材」这一个动作
zh.CATEGORY: AI 笔记 / 会议转录
zh.USER_SCALE: 官网自述 1M+ 用户、2,000+ 团队（未见第三方核实）；可核实的是 Product Hunt 4.8 分 / 39 条评论、1.7K 关注、六次发布记录
zh.BUSINESS_MODEL_SHORT: 免费档引流 + 四档订阅（Pro / Plus / Unlimited / Teams）+ 两款硬件；主要卖额度（转写分钟与作品数）
zh.STAGE_MATURITY: 成长期前期：2024 年上线，2025-02 起在 Product Hunt 反复上新（共六次），2026-08 推出主打本地转写的 Mac 版；同一 App Store ID 下换过三次名字（AI Notebook → AI Note Taker → HyNote）
zh.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: 已知：官网功能清单与五档定价原价、PH 评分与评论原文、六次发布记录、App Store 与 Google Play 商店条目、官网 MCP 入口。推断（已标 [推断]）：付费转化率、硬件营收占比、免费工具箱的流量结构、竞品定价。未测：T2 矛盾材料边界——实测（燃冰）判定它不做判断类工作，本报告不给结论。另：星标与护城河分均为我的评分，不是测量。
zh.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: 它把「输入」做到极宽、把「洞察」留白：好卖、好用，但护城河很薄。
zh.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: HyNote 用八种输入（录音、音视频、PDF、图片 OCR、YouTube、网页、电话、Apple Watch）把「素材」这件事吃干，再用 30+ 模板把素材压成能用的笔记；实测（燃冰）主链路 1 分钟出可用结果、2 分钟上手、导航一眼看懂。问题在于它卖的能力——转写、摘要、模板——都由模型供给，自己的差异只剩「入口多」，而入口多意味着 AI 账单随规模线性上涨。
zh.TLDR_1_BODY: 八种输入一个盒子，Apple Watch 都能录；实测（燃冰）主链路 1 分钟出可用结果，流程不用想。
zh.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: AI 在主干上，不在旁边
zh.TLDR_2_BODY: 不做 AI，转录出来的一万字没人看。所以它是 embedded，不是 optional——这一点和自带 key 的笔记产品正好相反。
zh.TLDR_3_BODY: 转写与摘要是可替换的模型能力，模板是工程量；成本却随成功上升。这就是实测（燃冰）那句「好但没护城河」的结构性原因。
zh.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: 实测（燃冰）：T1 主链路 1 分钟出可用结果，T4 上手 2 分钟、不用读教程；「有点意思」的一刻是把外部看到的东西一键变成自己的 inbox。
zh.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: 每次有会议、视频、PDF 或网页要消化，就触发一次；不是每日固定动作，所以留存靠「素材流」而不是「写日记的习惯」。
zh.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: 交互 6、数据归属 2、AI 3、生态 3、迁移成本 2，加权 3：交互最值钱，而数据归属与迁移成本几乎为零——导出即走。
zh.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: HyNote AI 是一款 AI 笔记与转录应用：把会议录音、音视频文件、PDF、图片、YouTube、网页、电话与 Apple Watch 八种素材导进来，用抽象式摘要与 30+ 专业模板产出可检索、可对话的笔记。官网自述 1M+ 用户 / 2,000+ 团队，定价从 $0 到 $24.99/月，另有 Teams 席位与两款硬件。
zh.USER_PROMISE: 官网首屏原话：Never take notes again；2026-08 Mac 版发布语：Free local transcription that is 100% Private。
zh.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: 它站在两排货架中间：左边是会议转录（Granola、Voicenotes、Jamie、Otter），右边是多模态知识库（NotebookLM 一类）。[推断] 它真正抢的是「只想开一个 App 把所有素材丢进去」的那一瞬间，不是某个具体功能。
zh.ASSUMPTION_1: [推断] 用户规模：1M+ 与 2,000+ Teams 均为官网自述，未见第三方核实；PH 4.8 / 39 条与 1.7K 关注是唯一可核实的公开社会证明。
zh.ASSUMPTION_2: [推断] 硬件收入：实测（燃冰）观察到官网 AI Devices 入口下有两款设备（录音设备、电子墨水笔记本），价格与销量官网未披露、本次未采集，故不写占比。
zh.SHOT_1_CAPTION: 商店首图：Never take notes again.（官方一句话定位，与实测（燃冰）的定位判断一致）
zh.SHOT_2_CAPTION: 内容详情页：Audio、Image、YouTube Video 混装在一份笔记里——输入广度就是它的卖点
zh.SHOT_3_CAPTION: Meeting Record：现场录音 + 实时转写 + 说话人标注，会后原地出纪要
zh.SHOT_4_CAPTION: Customize Note Templates：30+ 模板把「怎么写」变成「选哪个」
zh.SHOT_5_CAPTION: Note Assistant：对着自己的素材提问，笔记变成可对话的库
zh.SHOT_6_CAPTION: AI-Powered Second Brain：官方对自身定位的最后一层包装
zh.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: PM、销售、咨询：一天三场会，靠纪要跟进而非回听录音，要的是「扫一眼就能行动」。
zh.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: 把 PDF、讲义、YouTube 讲座、白板照片混在一起整理，要的是结构化笔记与复习材料（闪卡、思维导图、康奈尔笔记都是现成的模板）。
zh.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: 实测（燃冰）判断：真正的主力不是收藏癖，而是「面向流量做输出」的人——素材进来，很快要变成一条帖子、一份稿子。
zh.TRIGGER_MOMENT: 会议刚结束 / 看完一条长视频 / 收到一份 PDF 要先读完再回
zh.FREQUENCY: 每周多次（按素材流，不按日历）
zh.USAGE_CONTEXT: 手机端录制 + 桌面端整理 + Apple Watch 随手记；官网称跨 web、iPhone、Android、iPad、Apple Watch、Chrome 实时同步。
zh.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: 把形态各异的素材（录音、视频、PDF、截图、链接）压成一份能扫、能搜、能对话的结构化笔记，省掉「听一遍 + 抄一遍」。
zh.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: 不想事后回听两小时录音，也不想在会议里因为低头记笔记而错过现场。
zh.JTBD_SOCIAL: 散会十分钟内能发纪要、能说清行动项，看起来比同事更靠得住。
zh.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: 会议、视频、PDF、网页链接——它不要求你「打开 App 写点什么」，只要求你「丢东西进来」。
zh.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: 录音、上传、粘链接、拍图；AI 自动转写并按模板结构化。
zh.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: 摘要、要点、行动项自动分组（PH 官方回复确认行动项、决策、下一步会被识别并分段）。
zh.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: 产出越多，越倾向下次还丢给它；这是「素材流」型回访，不是「日记」型回访。
zh.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: 它教用户的不是记笔记，是「别自己整理」——把整理交给模型，用户只负责采集。
zh.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: PH 六次发布（2025-02-27 至 2026-08-20，Apple Watch 那次互动最高 63 / 313）+ 几十个 Free Tools 单点落地页做搜索长尾 [推断] + App Store / Google Play 双端自然量 + 官网 MCP 入口吸引开发者。
zh.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: 实测（燃冰）：把外部看到的东西一键变成自己的 inbox——转录即入库，比同类更贴合当下「先收再想」的习惯。
zh.RETENTION_1: 素材流本身：会议、课程、视频每周都有，一有素材就回访。
zh.RETENTION_2: 额度账本：转写分钟与作品额度是可感知的进度条，用得快的人为「别断」而续订。
zh.RETENTION_3: 跨设备铺设：Apple Watch + 手机 + 桌面 + Chrome，多点接触让人难以彻底卸载。
zh.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: 弱。产品内没有协作邀请与分享页，传播靠会议纪要外发（导出的笔记链接/文件）与 PH、App Store 的自然曝光；PH 评论里看不到「我拉了同事进来」这类话。
zh.SURFACE_1_ROLE: 打开就是「丢东西进来」的入口：八种输入摆在一屏，不用先建文件夹。
zh.SURFACE_2_ROLE: 转录、摘要、要点、行动项与模板分行呈现，下面接 Note Assistant。
zh.SURFACE_3_ROLE: 现场录音 + 实时转写 + 说话人标注，会后原地生成纪要。
zh.SURFACE_4_ROLE: 30+ 专业模板：SWOT、面试、学习笔记、跟进邮件——把「怎么写」变成「选哪个」。
zh.SURFACE_5_ROLE: 几十个单点工具（YouTube 摘要、闪卡、思维导图、康奈尔笔记、OCR…），既是 SEO 面也是付费漏斗的前端。
zh.SURFACE_6_ROLE: 硬件入口（录音设备、电子墨水笔记本）；实测（燃冰）判断这是它真正收钱的另一条腿。
zh.ENTITY_1: Note（一篇笔记，含转录与摘要）
zh.ENTITY_2: Transcript（带时间戳与说话人的原文）
zh.ENTITY_4: Source / 素材（录音、文件、链接、图片）
zh.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: 它的轴既不是时间也不是文件夹，是「素材」：进来先变成 Source，再变成 Note，再被模板压成结构。所以首页不是空白页而是收件口——这和以「今天」为轴的日记型产品是两种哲学：那种要你写，这种要你喂。
zh.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: 实测（燃冰）：导航清晰、一眼看得懂，2 分钟上手不用教程，两种登录（Google / Apple）。代价是入口过多——几十个 Free Tools 与主产品之间靠「用完了去升级」连接，而不是靠一套统一的信息架构。
zh.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: 把「整理」从用户手里拿走，只留下「喂素材」这一个动作；每多一种输入，用户就少一次心理准备。
zh.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: 录音、音视频、PDF、图片 OCR、YouTube、网页、电话、Apple Watch——不要求用户先想清楚这是什么类型。
zh.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: 官方在 PH 回复确认：会自动识别行动项、决策与下一步并分组为结构化段落，用户不必自己排版。
zh.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: 30+ 模板（SWOT、面试、跟进邮件）把「怎么写」变成「选哪个」，这是它比裸转录工具快的原因。
zh.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: Apple Watch 一键录音、回手机自动同步——把「采集」这一步的距离压到最短。
zh.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: 几十个单点工具做成独立落地页，既接搜索流量，也让用户注册前就体验到 AI 能力。
zh.TTV_LABEL: 价值到达时间：1 分钟（实测，主链路）
zh.COG_LABEL: 认知负荷：低（八种输入无需选类型、模板即填空；但工具箱入口过多容易散）
zh.DELIGHT_LABEL: 惊喜点：转录即入库 + Apple Watch 采集 + 行动项自动分组
zh.TRUST_LABEL: 信任：AES-256 静态加密、TLS 1.2+、托管 Google Cloud、GDPR/CCPA、声明不拿用户内容训练模型；但计费与退款有一条实名硬伤
zh.STRUGGLE_LABEL: 摩擦：免费额度不够会议量、抢话时说话人失准、模板与视觉结构有限、计费退款流程
zh.DELIGHT_1: 转录即入库：外部素材一键变自己的 inbox（实测（燃冰）认为这是最像智能的一刻）。
zh.DELIGHT_2: Apple Watch 采集：手腕上按下就录，回手机已转写并摘要（PH 原话 capturing thoughts on the wrist … genuinely convenient）。
zh.DELIGHT_3: 行动项自动分组：官方在 PH 回复确认会识别行动项、决策与下一步并结构化，省掉会后排版。
zh.STRUGGLE_1: 免费额度对会议多的人不够：PH 评论两次点名 the free tier isn't quite enough for the number of meetings on my calendar。
zh.STRUGGLE_2: 说话人标注在抢话时失准：PH 汇总原话 speaker labeling can slip in overlapping conversations。
zh.STRUGGLE_3: 模板与视觉结构有限，叠加计费退款硬伤：PH 汇总点名 templates and visual structure are limited；1★ 案例为官网付款后申请退款被指向 App Store 退款链接（官方已回复退款）。
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_NAME: 五档订阅 + 额度制 + 硬件
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: 定价页原价：Free $0；Pro $11.99/月（年付 $79.99 约合 $6.66/月，1200 转写分钟 + 300 作品额度）；Plus $18.99/月（年付 $129.99）；Unlimited $24.99/月（年付 $189.99，600 额度、无限存储、CRM 集成）；Teams $20/席/月（年付 $180/席，2 席起）。三档付费均含 7 天免费试用，年付最多省 45%。另有两款硬件（AI Devices；实测记录为录音设备与电子墨水笔记本），价格与销量未披露。
zh.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: 实测（燃冰）：墙在免费工具箱用完后进入 7 天试用，再进入订阅；免费版够日常，但产生依赖后不够——AI 功能内置不外放，真正限量的是「发布作品额度」与「私人空间额度」。
zh.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: 不做功能阉割，做额度上限：转写分钟（付费档 1200/月）、作品额度（300~600）、存储与 CRM；用得快就撞墙，撞墙就升级。
zh.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: 打架，而且对它不利：免费工具箱越好用，用户越早撞额度；AI 成本又逼它必须限额度。于是「好用」和「够用」在同一处对撞——PH 评论里「免费档不够」出现两次，就是这条缝。
zh.COMP_INTRO: 名单两处来源：PH 的 Similar Products 点了五家（Granola 4.8/57、Voicenotes 4.7/31、Speech to Note 5.0/24、Superpowered 4.6/57、Jamie 5.0/26），评论里用户实际拿来比的是 Voicenotes 与 Jamie。下面四家是我的判断，不是功能打分排名；竞品定价本次未采集，标「未核实」。
zh.COMP_OWN_D1: 八种（录音、音视频、PDF、图片 OCR、YouTube、网页、电话、Apple Watch）
zh.COMP_1_D1: 会议为主，桌面端录音 + 纪要
zh.COMP_2_D1: 语音笔记为主，输入形态更窄
zh.COMP_OWN_D2: 摘要 + 要点 + 行动项 + 30+ 模板 + 可对话
zh.COMP_1_D2: 纪要 + 模板，偏会议场景
zh.COMP_2_D2: 摘要 + 标签，偏快速记录
zh.COMP_OWN_D3: web / iPhone / Android / iPad / Apple Watch / Chrome + 两款硬件
zh.COMP_OWN_D4: Free $0；Pro 年付约 $6.66/月；Unlimited 年付约 $15.83/月；Teams $15/席/月；付费档 7 天试用
zh.COMP_1_D4: 有免费档；具体价格本次未核实
zh.COMP_2_D4: 有免费档；具体价格本次未核实
zh.COMP_3_D4: 付费为主；具体价格本次未核实
zh.COMP_4_D4: 单点低价；具体价格本次未核实
zh.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: 广度。同一份「散乱素材」，Granola 只吃会议音频、Speech to Note 只吃语音、Jamie 只做会议摘要，而它能一次吃掉会议录音 + 那份 PDF + 那条 YouTube + 白板照片，还都落进同一个可对话的笔记里。实测（燃冰）1 分钟出可用结果，正是这条广度换来的。
zh.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: 纵深与信任。用户若只做会议纪要，Jamie / Granola 的专注就赢；一旦追求更快更轻，Voicenotes 就赢；而计费退款那条 1★ 案例说明它的服务纵深还撑不住企业采购。
zh.CHANNEL_1: Product Hunt 六次发布（2025-02-27 至 2026-08-20），单次互动最高 63 / 313
zh.CHANNEL_2: 几十个 Free Tools 单点工具落地页（YouTube 摘要、SWOT、闪卡、思维导图、OCR…）接搜索长尾 [推断]
zh.CHANNEL_3: App Store 与 Google Play 双端自然量 + Apple Watch 端侧入口
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_1_NAME: 工具箱 SEO → 注册 → 额度耗尽 → 订阅
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: [推断] 单点工具页承接搜索意图（把长视频变摘要、把 PDF 变笔记），免费跑一次就把人带进产品，额度一断就转订阅。
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_2_NAME: 会议纪要外发 → 同事自下载 → 团队席位
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: [推断] 纪要外发给同事是最自然的传播动作，但产品内没有协作邀请机制，这条路目前只通向「同事自己下载」，还没通向 Teams 席位。
zh.HORIZONTAL_1: 从笔记扩到硬件（AI Devices：录音设备、电子墨水笔记本）
zh.HORIZONTAL_2: [推断] 从 App 扩到 MCP / agent 接口（hynote.ai/mcp）
zh.VERTICAL_1: 会议与销售跟进（纪要 + 行动项 + 跟进邮件模板）
zh.VERTICAL_2: 学习与考试（YouTube 讲座、PDF、闪卡、康奈尔笔记、思维导图）
zh.PLATFORM_1: 有 MCP Server 入口，但没有第三方插件市场或模板市场（官网无此类入口）
zh.PLATFORM_2: [推断] 开放接口目前是单向的「能被查」，还不是「能被写」的平台
zh.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: AI 在主干上：不做 AI，转录出来的一万字没人看。官网口径是抽象式摘要（abstractive summarization，不是关键词抽取）+ 30+ 模板 + Chat with notes + 最多 10 人说话人识别 + 50+ 语言。PH 官方回复确认会自动识别行动项、决策与下一步并分组。另有 MCP Server（hynote.ai/mcp）。实测（燃冰）：AI 内置不外放，用户不能自带 key，靠额度消费。
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_1: MCP Server 已存在：让外部 agent 读它的笔记库（hynote.ai/mcp）
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_2: 会后自动跟进：把行动项直接派到日历与任务，而不是留在笔记里等人抄
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: [推断] 自动决定「该记什么」：从被动等素材，变成在会议里主动判断哪段值得留
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: （我的判断）把 MCP 做成双向接口：agent 既能读也能写笔记，它就从工具变成记忆层
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: （我的判断）补洞察层：现在给摘要与要点，缺的是「这份材料对我的决策意味着什么」——实测（燃冰）说它给决策建议，但机制仍是摘要
zh.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: 两个方向：一是系统级录音与基础模型自带转录（手机与电脑原生就转写并摘要）直接吞掉入口；二是笔记与知识库类产品把「多模态导入」做成标配，它的广度优势归零。
zh.METRICS_INTRO: 没有任何公开运营指标。以下是可核实事实 + [推断]，用来说明「它该看什么」，不代表它真在看。
zh.NORTH_STAR_METRIC: 每周被喂进产品的素材数（Source 数）[推断]
zh.NORTH_STAR_WHY: [推断] 它的循环是「素材流」而不是「日记习惯」，所以「喂了多少素材」比 DAU 更贴价值主张；素材一停，留存立刻掉。
zh.INPUT_METRIC_1_NAME: 首日导入素材数 ≥2 的用户占比
zh.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: 单次导入只是尝鲜，两次以上才说明用户把它当成日常入口，这决定它能否从工具变习惯。
zh.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: 额度是它唯一的付费触发点，耗尽率直接等于「付费意愿的可达面」。
zh.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: 三档付费共用一个 7 天试用，这一条决定四档定价是否站得住。
zh.GUARDRAIL_METRIC: 说话人识别错误率与退款投诉数
zh.GUARDRAIL_WHY: 前者是被用户反复点名的质量问题（抢话场景），后者是唯一一条实名硬伤差评；两者一起塌，增长全部白费。
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT: 没有公开留存曲线、毛利率，也没有「每分钟 AI 成本」口径 [推断]
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: [推断] 它卖额度、成本却是推理账单；只看收入不看单位成本，越增长越难看的利润会被藏起来——实测（燃冰）的最大短板判断正落在这里。
zh.FRICTION_1_TITLE: 免费额度撑不住会议量
zh.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: PH 评论两次点名免费档不够用；实测（燃冰）：免费版够日常，但产生依赖后不够。它把付费触发点放在额度上，就等于把「好用」和「够用」做成同一件事。
zh.FRICTION_2_TITLE: 抢话时说话人标注会滑
zh.FRICTION_2_BODY: PH 汇总原话 speaker labeling can slip in overlapping conversations；官宣称最多支持 10 人识别，但真实会议里的重叠发言是它的软肋。
zh.FRICTION_3_BODY: PH 汇总原话 templates and visual structure are limited；一位评论者直接要求更多商务模板（图表、结构化图）。它把「怎么写」变成「选哪个」，可选的那层还不够厚。
zh.FRICTION_4_BODY: 1★ 案例：官网付款后申请退款，被指去 App Store 退款链接（实际非 App Store 购买）；在站点上点 upgrade 未确认即再次扣款。官方已回复退款，但流程信任已经受损。
zh.RISK_INTRO: 风险按「可能性 × 影响」排序；严重度是我的判断，不是官方披露。
zh.RISK_1_MIT: 按场景分配免费额度（会议 vs 学习），小模型做初筛、大模型只用于模板生成
zh.RISK_2_NAME: 品类被系统级录音与基础模型吞掉
zh.RISK_2_MIT: 把 MCP 双向化，占住「agent 的记忆层」而不是「更好的笔记 App」
zh.RISK_3_MIT: 退款自助化 + 扣费前二次确认，把 1★ 案例的复现成本压到最低
zh.RISK_4_NAME: 多品牌多名字导致资产分散
zh.RISK_4_MIT: App Store 同一 ID 下三次改名（AI Notebook → AI Note Taker → HyNote）、PH 发布六次；把资产收敛到单一品牌叙事
zh.OPP_1_HEADLINE: （我的判断）把 MCP 做成双向笔记层
zh.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: How：agent 可读也可写，把会议结论直接写回笔记。Why：这是它唯一不跟模型厂商抢的位置，也是唯一可能穿越「系统级录音」冲击的位置。
zh.OPP_2_HEADLINE: （我的判断）补洞察层，从摘要走到判断
zh.OPP_2_DETAIL: 实测（燃冰）说它给「决策建议」，但机制仍是摘要。把「这份材料改变了我哪个判断」做成固定输出，才是别人抄不走的差异。
zh.OPP_3_HEADLINE: （我的判断）把硬件与订阅绑成套餐
zh.OPP_3_DETAIL: 两款硬件是它唯一别人抄不动的入口（手腕采集）。买设备送额度、额度到期转订阅，比再堆十个免费工具值钱。
zh.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: 赌注：广度守入口，硬件守品类
zh.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: 用八种输入把「素材」吃干，让用户不必选 App；再用 Apple Watch 与两款硬件把「采集」压到物理最近的一步。这条路不跟模型厂商比模型，也不跟 Granola / Jamie 比纵深。
zh.MOONSHOT_HEADLINE: 终局：让「记笔记」这个动作消失
zh.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: 如果采集端铺到手腕与口袋、整理端交给模型，用户真正需要的不是笔记 App 而是一个「我的上下文库」。它的形态已经接近这个终点，问题在于敢不敢把这层库开放成接口。
zh.FINAL_WINS: 入口广度、1 分钟主链路、Apple Watch 采集、免费工具箱的获客面——四条都被实测与评论同时证实。
zh.FINAL_BREAKS: 要纵深的人（纯会议纪要）、要更轻更快的人（轻量语音笔记）、要企业级服务的人（计费退款事件）、要极致便宜的人（免费额度不够）。
zh.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: 薄。转写与摘要是公共能力，模板是工程量，硬件是唯一有物理门槛的一层；数据归属几乎为零——导出即走。

en.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: Never take notes again - it takes the organising away and leaves you one action: feed it material
en.USER_SCALE: Site claims 1M+ users and 2,000+ teams (no third-party verification); what can be verified is Product Hunt 4.8 from 39 reviews, 1.7K followers, six launches
en.BUSINESS_MODEL_SHORT: Free tier for acquisition plus four subscription tiers (Pro / Plus / Unlimited / Teams) and two hardware devices; what it actually sells is quota (transcription minutes and output credits)
en.STAGE_MATURITY: Early growth: launched in 2024, six Product Hunt launches from 2025-02, and a Mac build built around local transcription in 2026-08; the same App Store ID has carried three names (AI Notebook, AI Note Taker, HyNote)
en.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: Known: the official feature list and the five published prices, Product Hunt rating and review text, six launch records, the App Store and Google Play listings, the MCP entry point. Inferred (marked [inference]): paid conversion, hardware revenue share, the traffic structure behind the free tools, competitor pricing. Not tested: the T2 boundary with contradictory material - hands-on (RanBing) judged that it does not do judgement work, so this report draws no conclusion. The star rating and moat score are my scores, not measurements.
en.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: It makes the input side as wide as possible and leaves the insight side blank: easy to sell, easy to use, very thin moat.
en.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: HyNote swallows the whole material problem with eight inputs (recording, audio/video files, PDF, image OCR, YouTube, web pages, phone calls, Apple Watch), then compresses material into usable notes with 30+ templates; hands-on (RanBing) produced a usable result in one minute on the main path, was up and running in two minutes, and read the navigation at a glance. The problem is that everything it sells - transcription, summaries, templates - is supplied by models, so its own difference is just more doors, and more doors means an AI bill that grows with scale.
en.TLDR_1_BODY: Eight input types in one box, down to Apple Watch recording; hands-on (RanBing) got a usable result in one minute on the main path without thinking about process.
en.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: AI sits on the trunk, not beside it
en.TLDR_2_BODY: Without AI, ten thousand transcribed words go unread. So it is embedded, not optional - the exact opposite of note apps that ask you to bring your own key.
en.TLDR_3_BODY: Transcription and summarisation are replaceable model capabilities and templates are engineering work, while costs rise with success. That is the structural reason behind the hands-on verdict: good product, no moat.
en.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: Hands-on (RanBing): one minute to a usable result on the main path, two minutes to be up and running with no tutorial; the moment that felt smart was turning something external into your own inbox in one step.
en.LOOP_FREQ: Triggered by material (several times a week)
en.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: Every time there is a meeting, video, PDF or page to digest; it is not a daily ritual, so retention rides on the flow of material rather than on a diary habit.
en.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: Interaction 6, data ownership 2, AI 3, ecosystem 3, switching cost 2, weighted to 3: interaction is worth the most, while data ownership and switching cost are near zero - export and leave.
en.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: HyNote AI is an AI note-taking and transcription app: bring in meeting recordings, audio and video files, PDFs, images, YouTube links, web pages, phone calls or Apple Watch recordings, and get searchable, conversational notes produced by abstractive summarisation and 30+ professional templates. The site claims 1M+ users and 2,000+ teams, pricing runs from $0 to $24.99/month, with a Teams seat plan and two hardware devices on top.
en.USER_PROMISE: Homepage line: Never take notes again. Launch line for the 2026-08 Mac build: Free local transcription that is 100% Private.
en.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: It stands between two shelves: meeting transcription on the left (Granola, Voicenotes, Jamie, Otter) and multimodal knowledge bases on the right (the NotebookLM camp). [inference] What it really captures is the moment a user wants one app to throw every kind of material into, not any single feature.
en.ASSUMPTION_1: [inference] Scale: 1M+ users and 2,000+ teams are the site's own claims with no third-party check; Product Hunt 4.8 from 39 reviews and 1.7K followers are the only verifiable public proof.
en.ASSUMPTION_2: [inference] Hardware revenue: hands-on (RanBing) saw two devices behind the AI Devices entry (a recorder and an e-ink notebook), but prices and unit sales are not disclosed and were not captured, so no share is stated.
en.SHOT_1_CAPTION: Store hero: Never take notes again. - the official one-liner, matching the hands-on positioning
en.SHOT_2_CAPTION: Note detail: audio, image and YouTube video in one note - input breadth is the selling point
en.SHOT_3_CAPTION: Meeting Record: live recording, real-time transcription and speaker labels, with minutes produced on the spot
en.SHOT_4_CAPTION: Customize Note Templates: 30+ templates turn how do I write this into which one do I pick
en.SHOT_5_CAPTION: Note Assistant: ask questions of your own material, turning notes into a conversational library
en.SHOT_6_CAPTION: AI-Powered Second Brain: the official framing of what it wants to be
en.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: PMs, sales, consultants: three meetings a day, following up from notes rather than re-listening; they want a glance and an action.
en.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: PDFs, lecture slides, YouTube lectures and whiteboard photos mixed together; they want structured notes and revision material (flashcards, mind maps and Cornell notes are already templates).
en.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: Hands-on (RanBing) judgement: the real core user is not a collector but someone producing for an audience - material comes in and must quickly become a post or a draft.
en.TRIGGER_MOMENT: The meeting just ended / a long video just finished / a PDF arrived that must be read before replying
en.FREQUENCY: Several times a week, driven by material rather than the calendar
en.USAGE_CONTEXT: Record on the phone, organise on the desktop, capture on the Apple Watch; the site claims real-time sync across web, iPhone, Android, iPad, Apple Watch and Chrome.
en.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: Compress wildly different material (recordings, video, PDFs, screenshots, links) into one scannable, searchable, conversational note, removing listen-once-and-copy-once.
en.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: No desire to re-listen to a two-hour recording afterwards, and no desire to miss the room because you were heads-down writing.
en.JTBD_SOCIAL: Send minutes and name the action items within ten minutes of the meeting, and look more reliable than the colleague who did not.
en.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: Meetings, video, PDFs, links - it never asks you to open the app and write something, only to throw something in.
en.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: Record, upload, paste a link, take a photo; AI transcribes and structures it against a template.
en.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: Summary, key points and action items grouped automatically (the official reply on Product Hunt confirms action items, decisions and next steps are detected and separated).
en.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: The more it produces, the more likely you throw the next thing at it; this is material-flow retention, not diary retention.
en.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: What it teaches is not note-taking but not organising yourself - hand the organising to the model and keep only the capture.
en.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: Six Product Hunt launches (2025-02-27 to 2026-08-20, the Apple Watch one peaking at 63 / 313) plus dozens of Free Tools landing pages catching search long tail [inference], organic App Store and Google Play traffic, and the MCP entry point aimed at developers.
en.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: Hands-on (RanBing): turning something external into your own inbox in one step - transcription straight into the library, closer to how people collect first and think later.
en.RETENTION_1: The material flow itself: meetings, courses and videos arrive weekly, and each arrival brings a visit.
en.RETENTION_2: The quota ledger: transcription minutes and output credits are a visible progress bar, and heavy users renew so it does not run out.
en.RETENTION_3: Device spread: Apple Watch, phone, desktop and Chrome mean several touchpoints, which makes uninstalling feel costly.
en.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: Weak. There is no in-product invite or share page; spread comes from sending minutes out (exported notes and files) and from organic Product Hunt and App Store exposure. No review says a colleague was pulled in.
en.SURFACE_1_ROLE: The first screen is an intake: eight input types on one screen, no folder to create first.
en.SURFACE_2_ROLE: Transcript, summary, key points, action items and template output laid out in rows, with Note Assistant underneath.
en.SURFACE_3_ROLE: Live recording, real-time transcription and speaker labels; minutes generated on the spot.
en.SURFACE_4_ROLE: 30+ professional templates - SWOT, interviews, study notes, follow-up emails - turning how to write into which to pick.
en.SURFACE_5_ROLE: Dozens of single-purpose tools (YouTube summariser, flashcards, mind map, Cornell notes, OCR and more) that act as both SEO surface and top of the paid funnel.
en.SURFACE_6_ROLE: The hardware entry (a recorder and an e-ink notebook); hands-on (RanBing) reads this as the other leg that actually earns money.
en.ENTITY_1: Note (one note containing transcript and summary)
en.ENTITY_2: Transcript (text with timestamps and speaker labels)
en.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: Its axis is neither time nor folders but material: something arrives as a Source, becomes a Note, and is compressed into structure by a template. That is why the first screen is an intake rather than a blank page - the opposite philosophy from a daily-note product: one asks you to write, this one asks you to feed.
en.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: Hands-on (RanBing): the navigation is clear and readable at a glance, two minutes to be productive with no tutorial, and two sign-in options (Google and Apple). The cost is too many doors - dozens of Free Tools connect to the main product through finish-this-then-upgrade rather than through one coherent information architecture.
en.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: Take the organising away and leave only feeding material in; every extra input type removes one more moment of preparation.
en.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: Recording, audio/video files, PDF, image OCR, YouTube, web pages, phone calls, Apple Watch - the user never has to classify the file first.
en.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: The official reply on Product Hunt confirms action items, decisions and next steps are detected and grouped into structured paragraphs, so no post-meeting formatting is needed.
en.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: 30+ templates (SWOT, interviews, follow-up emails) turn how to write into which to pick - the reason it is faster than raw transcription tools.
en.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: One tap on the Apple Watch, synced back to the phone already transcribed - the shortest possible distance for the capture step.
en.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: Dozens of single-purpose tools as standalone landing pages, catching search traffic and letting people touch the AI before signing up.
en.TTV_LABEL: Time to value: 1 minute (hands-on, main path)
en.COG_LABEL: Cognitive load: low (eight inputs need no classification, templates are fill-in; but too many toolkit doors makes it feel scattered)
en.DELIGHT_LABEL: Delight: transcription straight into the library, Apple Watch capture, action items grouped automatically
en.TRUST_LABEL: Trust: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+, hosted on Google Cloud, GDPR and CCPA alignment, a stated no-training-on-your-content policy; but billing and refunds carry one named hard failure
en.STRUGGLE_LABEL: Friction: free quota too small for meeting volume, speaker labels slip when people talk over each other, limited templates and visual structure, billing and refund flow
en.DELIGHT_1: Transcription straight into the library: external material becomes your inbox in one step (hands-on, RanBing: the moment that felt smart).
en.DELIGHT_2: Apple Watch capture: tap on the wrist, and it is already transcribed and summarised on the phone (review: capturing thoughts on the wrist genuinely convenient).
en.DELIGHT_3: Action items grouped automatically: the official reply confirms action items, decisions and next steps are detected and structured, removing post-meeting formatting.
en.STRUGGLE_1: Free quota too small for meeting-heavy users: two reviews say the free tier is not quite enough for the number of meetings on the calendar.
en.STRUGGLE_2: Speaker labels slip when people talk over each other: the Product Hunt summary says speaker labeling can slip in overlapping conversations.
en.STRUGGLE_3: Limited templates and visual structure plus a billing failure: the summary names templates and visual structure as limited, and one 1-star review describes being sent to an App Store refund link after paying on the website (officially answered and refunded).
en.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: Published prices: Free $0; Pro $11.99/month ($79.99 a year, about $6.66/month, 1,200 transcription minutes plus 300 credits); Plus $18.99/month ($129.99 a year); Unlimited $24.99/month ($189.99 a year, 600 credits, unlimited storage, CRM integration); Teams $20 per seat per month ($180 per seat a year, two seats minimum). The three paid tiers include a 7-day free trial and annual billing saves up to 45%. Two hardware devices also exist (AI Devices; hands-on records a recorder and an e-ink notebook), prices and unit sales not disclosed.
en.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: Hands-on (RanBing): the wall is running out of free toolkit usage, then a 7-day trial, then a subscription; the free tier covers daily use but not dependence - AI is built in and not bring-your-own-key, so what is actually capped is output credits and private space.
en.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: No feature crippling, only ceilings: transcription minutes (1,200 a month on paid tiers), output credits (300 to 600), storage and CRM; use it hard, hit the ceiling, upgrade.
en.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: They do, and not in its favour: the better the free tools work, the sooner users hit the ceiling, while AI cost forces it to cap them. Good and enough collide in the same place - two reviews saying the free tier is not enough are exactly that seam.
en.COMP_INTRO: The list comes from two places: the Similar Products block on Product Hunt (Granola 4.8/57, Voicenotes 4.7/31, Speech to Note 5.0/24, Superpowered 4.6/57, Jamie 5.0/26), and the rivals reviewers actually compare against (Voicenotes and Jamie). The four below are my judgement, not a feature ranking; competitor pricing was not captured this time and is marked unverified.
en.COMP_OWN_D1: Eight types (recording, audio/video, PDF, image OCR, YouTube, web page, phone call, Apple Watch)
en.COMP_OWN_D2: Summary, key points, action items, 30+ templates, conversational
en.COMP_OWN_D3: web, iPhone, Android, iPad, Apple Watch, Chrome plus two devices
en.COMP_OWN_D4: Free $0; Pro about $6.66/month annual; Unlimited about $15.83/month annual; Teams $15 per seat per month; 7-day trial on paid tiers
en.COMP_1_D4: Has a free tier; exact price not verified this time
en.COMP_2_D4: Has a free tier; exact price not verified this time
en.COMP_3_D4: Mostly paid; exact price not verified this time
en.COMP_4_D4: Low single-purpose price; not verified this time
en.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: Breadth. Given the same messy pile, Granola only takes the meeting audio, Speech to Note only takes speech, Jamie only summarises meetings, while HyNote takes the recording, the PDF, the YouTube link and the whiteboard photo and lands them in one conversational note. The one-minute hands-on result came from that breadth.
en.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: Depth and trust. If a user only needs meeting minutes, Jamie and Granola win on focus; if they want lighter and faster, Voicenotes wins; and the 1-star billing case shows service depth is not yet enough for company procurement.
en.CHANNEL_1: Six Product Hunt launches (2025-02-27 to 2026-08-20), best single launch 63 / 313
en.CHANNEL_2: Dozens of Free Tools landing pages (YouTube summariser, SWOT, flashcards, mind map, OCR and more) catching search long tail [inference]
en.CHANNEL_3: Organic App Store and Google Play traffic plus the Apple Watch entry point
en.GROWTH_LOOP_1_NAME: Toolkit SEO to signup to quota to subscription
en.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: [inference] Single-purpose pages catch search intent (turn a long video into a summary, turn a PDF into notes), one free run brings the user inside, and the quota running out converts them.
en.GROWTH_LOOP_2_NAME: Minutes sent out to colleagues to team seats
en.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: [inference] Sending minutes out is the most natural spread action, but there is no in-product invite, so the path only reaches a colleague downloading it, not yet a Teams seat.
en.HORIZONTAL_1: From notes into hardware (AI Devices: a recorder and an e-ink notebook)
en.HORIZONTAL_2: [inference] From app into MCP and agent interfaces (hynote.ai/mcp)
en.VERTICAL_1: Meetings and sales follow-up (minutes, action items, follow-up email templates)
en.VERTICAL_2: Study and exams (YouTube lectures, PDFs, flashcards, Cornell notes, mind maps)
en.PLATFORM_1: An MCP server entry exists, but there is no third-party plugin or template marketplace (no such entry on the site)
en.PLATFORM_2: [inference] The open interface is read-only for now: it can be queried, it cannot be written to
en.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: AI sits on the trunk: without it, ten thousand words of transcript go unread. The official framing is abstractive summarisation (not keyword extraction) plus 30+ templates, Chat with notes, speaker identification for up to 10 participants and 50+ languages. The official Product Hunt reply confirms action items, decisions and next steps are detected and grouped. An MCP server is also published (hynote.ai/mcp). Hands-on (RanBing): AI is built in and cannot be swapped for your own key, and it is consumed through quota.
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_1: The MCP server already exists: let an external agent read the note library (hynote.ai/mcp)
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_2: Automatic follow-up: push action items into calendar and tasks instead of leaving them in a note to be copied
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: [inference] Decide what is worth keeping: from waiting for material to judging inside a meeting which minute matters
en.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: (my judgement) Make MCP two-way: an agent can read and write, and it becomes a memory layer rather than a tool
en.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: (my judgement) Add an insight layer: it already gives summaries and key points but not what this material changes about my decision - hands-on (RanBing) heard decision advice, yet the mechanism is still summarisation
en.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: Two directions: system-level recording with built-in model transcription (phones and computers transcribing and summarising natively) eats the entry point, and note or knowledge-base products making multimodal import standard erases its breadth advantage.
en.METRICS_INTRO: No operating metrics are public. What follows is verifiable fact plus [inference], written to argue what it should watch, not to claim it does.
en.NORTH_STAR_METRIC: Sources fed into the product per week [inference]
en.NORTH_STAR_WHY: [inference] Its loop is material flow rather than a diary habit, so how much material is fed in fits its promise better than DAU; stop the material and retention drops immediately.
en.INPUT_METRIC_1_NAME: Share of users importing two or more sources on day one
en.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: A single import is a taste test; a second one shows the product became a daily door, which decides whether it turns from tool into habit.
en.INPUT_METRIC_2_NAME: Free quota exhaustion rate in the first month
en.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: Quota is its only payment trigger, so exhaustion rate is literally the reachable surface of willingness to pay.
en.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: All three paid tiers share one 7-day trial, and this number decides whether four price points stand up.
en.GUARDRAIL_METRIC: Speaker-identification error rate and refund complaints
en.GUARDRAIL_WHY: The first is the only quality issue reviewers repeat (overlapping speech), the second is the only named hard failure; if both degrade, all growth is wasted.
en.METRIC_BLINDSPOT: No public retention curve, no gross margin, and no per-minute AI cost figure [inference]
en.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: [inference] It sells quota while its cost is an inference bill; reading revenue without unit cost hides a margin that gets worse as it grows - exactly where the hands-on biggest weakness lands.
en.FRICTION_1_TITLE: Free quota cannot carry meeting volume
en.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: Two reviews say the free tier is not enough; hands-on (RanBing): free covers daily use but not dependence. Putting the payment trigger on quota makes good and enough the same question.
en.FRICTION_2_TITLE: Speaker labels slip when people talk over each other
en.FRICTION_2_BODY: The Product Hunt summary says speaker labeling can slip in overlapping conversations; the site claims up to 10 speakers, but overlapping speech in real meetings is the soft spot.
en.FRICTION_3_TITLE: Templates and visual structure are limited
en.FRICTION_3_BODY: The summary names templates and visual structure as limited, and a reviewer asks for more business templates (charts, structured diagrams). It turns how to write into which to pick, but the shelf of choices is thin.
en.FRICTION_4_BODY: A 1-star case: after paying on the website, the refund request was pointed to an App Store refund link that did not apply, and clicking upgrade on the site charged again without confirmation. The company replied and refunded, but process trust took the hit.
en.RISK_INTRO: Risks are ordered by likelihood times impact; severity is my judgement, not a disclosure.
en.RISK_1_MIT: Allocate free quota by scenario (meetings versus study), screen with a small model and spend the large model only on template generation
en.RISK_2_NAME: The category is absorbed by system recording and base models
en.RISK_2_MIT: Make MCP two-way and hold the agent memory layer rather than being a better note app
en.RISK_3_NAME: A billing and refund trust incident
en.RISK_3_MIT: Self-serve refunds and a confirmation step before any charge, to keep the cost of repeating the 1-star case near zero
en.RISK_4_NAME: Multiple names split the brand asset
en.RISK_4_MIT: One App Store ID has carried three names (AI Notebook, AI Note Taker, HyNote) across six Product Hunt launches; converge the story on a single brand
en.OPP_1_HEADLINE: (my judgement) Make MCP a two-way note layer
en.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: How: let an agent read and write, so meeting conclusions land back in the note. Why: it is the one position model vendors are not fighting for, and the only one that may survive system-level recording.
en.OPP_2_HEADLINE: (my judgement) Add the insight layer, from summary to judgement
en.OPP_2_DETAIL: Hands-on (RanBing) heard decision advice, but the mechanism is still summarisation. Making what this changes about my decision a fixed output is the part nobody can copy quickly.
en.OPP_3_HEADLINE: (my judgement) Bind hardware and subscription into one package
en.OPP_3_DETAIL: The two devices are the only door competitors cannot copy (wrist capture). Buy the device, get credits, credits turn into a subscription - worth more than ten more free tools.
en.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: The bet: breadth holds the entry, hardware holds the category
en.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: Use eight inputs to swallow the material problem so users never choose an app, then use the Apple Watch and two devices to push capture to the physically nearest step. It does not compete with model vendors on models, nor with Granola and Jamie on depth.
en.MOONSHOT_HEADLINE: Endgame: make note-taking disappear as an action
en.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: If capture reaches the wrist and the pocket and organisation is handed to a model, what people need is not a note app but a context library about themselves. HyNote's shape is already close; the question is whether it dares open that library as an interface.
en.FINAL_WINS: Input breadth, the one-minute main path, Apple Watch capture and the acquisition surface of the free tools - all four confirmed by both hands-on and reviews.
en.FINAL_BREAKS: Anyone who wants depth (pure meeting minutes), anyone who wants lighter and faster (light voice notes), anyone who needs enterprise-grade service (the billing case), anyone who needs it to be cheap (free quota is not enough).
en.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: Thin. Transcription and summarisation are common capabilities, templates are engineering work, hardware is the only layer with a physical barrier, and data ownership is nearly zero - export and leave.

extra_zh.title: 对标竞品地图
extra_zh.body:
先给一个探测结果，因为它本身就是结论的一半。Product Hunt 的 Similar Products 只点了五家，全在「会议纪要」货架上：Granola 4.8（57）、Voicenotes 4.7（31）、Speech to Note 5.0（24）、Superpowered 4.6（57）、Jamie 5.0（26）。而它自己首页导航里的 Compare 指向的是 Otter / Fireflies / NotebookLM 那一派——说明它认的对手和平台给它标的对手不是同一批。

我的判断：这五家里只有 Voicenotes 与 Jamie 是真对手，因为评论里用户自己就在比这两个（"Voicenotes is lighter and faster"、"Jamie seems great if all you care about is meeting summaries"）。Granola 与 Speech to Note 抢的是单点，NotebookLM 抢的是「把资料变知识库」那一层。真正的威胁不在这张表上——是手机与电脑系统自带的录音转写。

谁Product Hunt 评分抢的是哪一段
Granola4.8（57）Mac 桌面端的会议纪要，重体验轻广度
Voicenotes4.7（31）更轻更快的语音笔记
Jamie5.0（26）只做会议摘要，做深
Speech to Note5.0（24）单点语音转文字，价格敏感人群
Superpowered4.6（57）会议记录 + 团队协作
Otter / Fireflies / NotebookLM—官网 Compare 页自认的对手：会议室机器人与知识库

G2 这次采集失败（0 条，见证据索引），所以「差评迁移去向」这一栏本报告不给结论——样本不足，我不编。竞品定价本次未采集，表中不写价格。

extra_zh.title: 竞品技术底座
extra_zh.body:
一句话一家，看底座选择换来了什么、锁死了什么：

产品底座选择锁住了什么锁死了什么
HyNote AI云端多模态管线（AES-256 + TLS 1.2+ + Google Cloud）+ 30+ 模板 + 额度制 + 两款硬件输入广度、跨端采集（Apple Watch）、即开即用的结构化自带模型/自带 key、数据归属（导出即走）、企业级服务纵深
Granola桌面端优先的会议笔记，重本地体验开会的体感与排版多模态素材、移动与穿戴端
Voicenotes轻量语音笔记，输入窄速度与轻复杂工作流与长文素材
Jamie只做会议音频接入与摘要纵深与准确度叙事广度，任何非会议素材
Otter / Fireflies会议室机器人 + 团队协作团队流程与合规无机器人场景、个人轻量使用

[推断] 护城河结论：HyNote 的底座是「广度」，而广度是最容易被复制的一层——八种输入是工程量，不是壁垒。它唯一有物理门槛的是硬件（手腕采集）；唯一有可能长出网络效应的是会议纪要外发，但它没有做协作邀请，那条路目前是断的。

extra_zh.title: 可迁移的机会
extra_zh.body:
三条，都是我的判断，不是它的路线图：

（我的判断）一、把 MCP Server 从「能查」做成「双向」。官网已经有 hynote.ai/mcp。现在 agent 最多能读它的笔记；一旦能写，会议结论就能直接落回笔记库，它从「一个 App」变成「一层记忆」。这是唯一不跟模型厂商抢的位置。

（我的判断）二、补洞察层，从摘要走到判断。实测（燃冰）说它「给到决策建议」，但打开看机制还是摘要与要点。把「这份材料改变了我哪个判断」做成固定输出，才是别人抄不走的差异——摘要人人都有，判断没有。

（我的判断）三、把硬件与订阅绑成套餐。两款硬件（录音设备、电子墨水笔记本）是它唯一别人抄不动的入口：手腕与桌面采集是物理距离最近的一步。买设备送额度、额度用完转订阅，比再堆十个免费工具值钱得多。

extra_zh.title: 流量与变现拆解
extra_zh.body:
定价事实先摆清：五档，Free $0；Pro $11.99/月（年付 $79.99，约合 $6.66/月，1200 转写分钟 + 300 作品额度）；Plus $18.99/月（年付 $129.99）；Unlimited $24.99/月（年付 $189.99）；Teams $20/席/月（年付 $180/席，2 席起）。三档付费均含 7 天试用，年付最多省 45%。另有两款硬件，价格与销量未披露。

三问框架走一遍：

问题答案依据
谁付钱有输出压力的个人，其次是小团队采购四档个人订阅 + Teams 两席起；官网自述 2,000+ 团队
为什么付为「额度别断」付，不为功能解锁付定价差在转写分钟、作品额度、存储与 CRM，功能表基本一致
能付多久取决于它比系统自带转录贵出的那部分值不值实测（燃冰）会留下：很实惠，内置大模型叠加这么多功能但比大模型省钱

流量结构 [推断]：两条腿。一条是 PH 六次发布 + App Store / Google Play 自然量（面向普通用户），另一条是几十个 Free Tools 单点落地页（面向搜索意图，比如「YouTube 视频转摘要」）。前者做声量，后者做长尾转化——这条链没有公开数据，只能标推断。

最脆的一根梁：它卖的是额度，成本是推理账单。免费工具箱越好用，用户越快撞额度；额度给得越宽松，毛利越薄。这个结构不改，增长本身会让报表更难看。

extra_en.title: Competitive map
extra_en.body:
Start with a probe result, because it is half the finding. The Similar Products block on Product Hunt names only five neighbours, all on the meeting-notes shelf: Granola 4.8 (57), Voicenotes 4.7 (31), Speech to Note 5.0 (24), Superpowered 4.6 (57), Jamie 5.0 (26). Yet the Compare link in its own navigation points at Otter, Fireflies and NotebookLM - the rivals it names for itself are not the ones the platform lists.

My judgement: only Voicenotes and Jamie are real rivals here, because reviewers compare against exactly those two ("Voicenotes is lighter and faster", "Jamie seems great if all you care about is meeting summaries"). Granola and Speech to Note take single points; NotebookLM takes the turn-your-files-into-a-knowledge-base layer. The real threat is not on this table at all - it is the recording and transcription built into phones and computers.

WhoProduct Hunt scoreWhich slice it takes
Granola4.8 (57)Mac desktop meeting notes, experience over breadth
Voicenotes4.7 (31)Lighter, faster voice notes
Jamie5.0 (26)Meeting summaries only, in depth
Speech to Note5.0 (24)Single-purpose speech to text, price-sensitive users
Superpowered4.6 (57)Meeting capture plus team collaboration
Otter / Fireflies / NotebookLMn/aThe rivals its own Compare page names: room bots and knowledge bases

The G2 capture failed this time (zero rows, see evidence index), so this report draws no conclusion on where unhappy users migrate. Competitor pricing was not collected either, so no prices appear in the table.

extra_en.title: Competitor technical substrate
extra_en.body:
One line each: what the substrate buys and what it locks out.

ProductSubstrate choiceWhat it securesWhat it forecloses
HyNote AICloud multimodal pipeline (AES-256, TLS 1.2+, Google Cloud), 30+ templates, quota model, two hardware devicesInput breadth, cross-device capture including Apple Watch, structure out of the boxBring your own model or key, data ownership (export and leave), enterprise service depth
GranolaDesktop-first meeting notes with a strong local feelIn-meeting feel and layoutMultimodal material, mobile and wearable capture
VoicenotesLight voice notes, narrow inputSpeed and lightnessComplex workflows and long documents
JamieMeeting audio in, summary outDepth and accuracy narrativeBreadth, anything that is not a meeting
Otter / FirefliesRoom bot plus team collaborationTeam process and complianceNo-bot settings, light personal use

[inference] Moat conclusion: HyNote's substrate is breadth, which is the easiest layer to copy - eight inputs are engineering work, not a barrier. The only physical barrier it owns is hardware (wrist capture); the only place a network effect could grow is minutes sent to colleagues, and with no invite flow that path is currently cut.

extra_en.title: Transferable opportunities
extra_en.body:
Three, all my judgement rather than its roadmap:

(my judgement) One: make the MCP server two-way. hynote.ai/mcp already exists. Today an agent can read notes at best; once it can write, meeting conclusions land straight back in the library and the product becomes a memory layer rather than an app. It is the only position model vendors are not fighting for.

(my judgement) Two: add the insight layer. Hands-on (RanBing) said it offers decision advice, but the mechanism is still summaries and key points. Making what this changes about my decision a fixed output is the part nobody copies quickly - everyone has summaries, nobody has judgement.

(my judgement) Three: bundle hardware with subscription. The two devices (a recorder and an e-ink notebook) are the only door competitors cannot copy, because wrist and desk capture sit at the shortest physical distance. Buy the device, get credits, credits become a subscription - worth far more than ten more free tools.

extra_en.title: Traffic and monetisation
extra_en.body:
Pricing facts first: five tiers. Free $0; Pro $11.99/month ($79.99 a year, about $6.66/month, 1,200 transcription minutes and 300 credits); Plus $18.99/month ($129.99 a year); Unlimited $24.99/month ($189.99 a year); Teams $20 per seat per month ($180 per seat a year, two seats minimum). The three paid tiers include a 7-day trial and annual billing saves up to 45%. Two hardware devices exist as well, with prices and unit sales undisclosed.

The three questions:

QuestionAnswerBasis
Who paysIndividuals with output pressure, then small-team procurementFour individual tiers plus Teams from two seats; the site claims 2,000+ teams
Why they paySo the quota does not run out, not to unlock featuresTiers differ on minutes, credits, storage and CRM; the feature table is largely the same
How long they keep payingAs long as the premium over built-in transcription stays worth itHands-on (RanBing) would stay: affordable, a built-in model with this many features for less than the model would cost

Traffic structure [inference]: two legs. Six Product Hunt launches plus organic App Store and Google Play traffic aimed at ordinary users, and dozens of Free Tools landing pages aimed at search intent (turn a YouTube video into a summary). The first builds noise, the second builds long-tail conversion - no public data on that chain, so it stays an inference.

The weakest beam: it sells quota while its cost is an inference bill. The better the free tools, the sooner users hit the ceiling; the looser the quota, the thinner the margin. Unless that structure changes, growth itself makes the numbers look worse.
